newsitem.title: JAPAN: Russian PGM shipments to Japan to arrive Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Russian PGM shipments to Japan to arrive Thursday.

text.p: Russia's first platinum group metals (PGM) shipments to Japan in six months are due to arrive on Thursday, Japanese traders said.

"The long-awaited Russian PGM deliveries to Japan are expected to arrive on Thursday as scheduled, and the metals are expected to flow into the Japanese market next week," a senior trader at a major Japanese trading house said.
"I think this will be the end of the 'Russia factor' (in the market)," the trader said.
Russian exports of PGMs under long-term contracts had been suspended since the beginning of the year due to bureaucratic disputes and other domestic problems in Russia.
The Russian PGM export agency Almazjuvelirexport informed its Japanese clients last week that Russia would resume PGM exports to Japan around July 10.
Japan is the world's largest PGM consumer. Russia supplies more than 60 percent of the world's palladium and about 20 percent of its platinum.
